ana: Customer ACCT-987 raised a weird invoice issue. INV-2026-0421-389 shows a -€0.01 line called 'embedding credit proration' and the explicit line-item sum doesn't match the invoice total. They say dashboard usage and raw export match our usage, but invoice aggregation/rounding looks off. csv excerpt pasted below.

sam: Can you drop invoice id, account id (got it), region (EU?), and full billing export? Also did they use pre-purchased credits or automatic credits?

ana: Invoice + export: region=EU, VAT=20%, credits = pre-purchased monthly credits applied at invoice time. CSV snippet:```
line_item_id,description,pre_tax_amount,vat_amount,gross_amount
L1,embeddings call,0.01,0.00,0.01
L2,embeddings call,0.01,0.00,0.01
L3,embeddings call,0.01,0.00,0.01
C1,credit proration,-0.03,0.00,-0.03
VAT,vat on charges,0.01,0.00,0.01
TOTAL,,0.00,0.01,0.01
```

ana: The customer says the dashboard shows total pre-tax usage €0.039 -> VAT 20% -> invoice total €0.0468 rounded to €0.05, but our invoice shows a separate negative credit line and then the totals end up off by €0.01 in line-item summation. They get nervous when an invoice shows an explicit negative cent line.

jules: :eyes: This screams per-line rounding + credit proration ordering. If credits are prorated per-line and we round each prorated credit to cents, small fractional leftovers can produce a -€0.01 residual that we currently render as a discrete line. Quick manual calc: pre-tax usage 0.039 -> prorate credits of 0.03 across 3 lines -> raw per-line credit = 0.01 exactly? but depending on rounding order with VAT it can flip sign once we apply VAT per line vs total vat rounding.

sam: Can you include the raw microcent (internal smallest unit) export? Need to know whether we store values in micros and then round only at presentation or if we do early rounding in proration step.

ana: Pasted extracted export (internal fields):```
charge_units=[13,13,13]  # embedding units (in 1/1000s)
unit_price_eur_micros=10000  # 0.01 EUR in micros
total_charge_micros=39000
credit_total_micros=30000
prorated_credits_micros=[10000,10000,10000]
prorated_credits_rounded_cents=[0.01,0.01,0.01]
remainder_micros= -1000  # -0.001 EUR leftover after rounding
```

mike-eng: Thanks — reproducible. Root cause: our proration algorithm computes prorated_credits by dividing in micros then immediately rounds to cents for the invoice line. That rounding can produce a negative remainder_micros when credit_total isn't divisible into the small line buckets. We then emit a separate line for the remainder with sign flipped rather than absorbing it deterministically, which creates the -€0.01 artifact. Also VAT gets applied per-line in the renderer which doubles rounding noise.

mike-eng: Proposed fix: do all proration math in integer micros at high precision, allocate remainder deterministically (add leftover micros to the largest charge line), only round at presentation for each line so sum(line_rounded) == rounded(total). Also ensure VAT rounding is consistent: apply VAT to aggregated pre-tax total then distribute VAT rounding to lines, or compute VAT per line but use the same deterministic remainder distribution. I'll open RED-12345 and push a PR for the proration util.

billing-bot: Automated scan flagged 7 invoices in last 7 days with similar negative-cent proration lines (all EU VAT). Ticket RED-12345 created and linked.

jules: Immediate customer action: issue corrected credit note for INV-2026-0421-389 showing adjusted line (refund €0.01) and regenerated invoice PDF, and email customer with explanation. I can handle issuing the credit note once eng confirms fix approach.

sam: Can eng provide a staging patch and a short repro script so accounting can validate before we touch production? Also we should search invoices for that negative-cent line and prepare customer communications.

mike-eng: I'll prepare a small repro script (python) that creates 3 tiny embedding charges and a credit and shows both current proration and corrected proration. ETA: staging PR in 36h, review + staging test in 24h after that. Owner: mike-eng. Work items: RED-12345 - proration deterministic allocation, RED-12346 - vat rounding normalization, RED-12347 - backfill detection of existing invoices and remediation list.

ana: Thanks — I'll tell the customer we're escalating, offering a manual credit note in the interim, and we'll follow up when fix is deployed. Customer asked for ETA; I'll give 72 hours.

sam: Great. Also logging note: add a debug flag to proration path so we can capture the micros -> rounded mapping for affected invoices (useful for support repro).

mike-eng: Will add logging. Leaving this thread attached to RED-12345.

billing-bot: Added label "billing:proration-rounding" and alerted finance-oncall.
